newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia sees growth, profits staying strong.
newsitem.headline: Nokia sees growth, profits staying strong.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said on Thursday it expected its strong grwoth and profitability to continue in 1997.

"On an overall basis, we believe that we are well positioned to exploit new opportunities during 1997 and that Nokia will continue to demonstrate strong growth and good profitability," CEO Jorma Ollila said in a statement with the company's 1996 results.
"At the end of 1996, we were the global market leader in digital mobile phones, one of the largest suppliers of GSM networks, and the world's leading supplier of DCS 1800 systems," Ollila said.
Nokia also said it would begin marketing a GSM 1900 version of the Nokia 9000 Communicator in the Americas in 1997.
"Additionally, in the summer (of) 1997, we intend to introduce our first IS-95 (CDMA) mobile phone," Ollila said in the statement.
